body_text: View All News Avantor® Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results July 29, 2026 Download (opens in new window) Net sales of $1,692.3 million; increase of 0.5%; organic decline of 0.4% Net income of $38.1 million; Adjusted EBITDA of $254.3 million Diluted GAAP EPS of $0.06; adjusted EPS of $0.21 Operating cash flow of $178.2 million; free cash flow of $142.8 million Increases FY 2026 organic revenue growth and adjusted EPS guidance RADNOR, Pa. , July 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Avantor, Inc. (NYSE: AVTR), a leading global provider of mission-critical products and services to customers in the life sciences and advanced technology industries, reports better than expected results for the second fiscal quarter of 2026. Emmanuel Ligner, President and Chief Executive Officer, says: "Our Revival program is strengthening how we serve our customers, leading to improved business performance. "Our second quarter results exceeded our expectations across several key financial metrics, and we generated robust free cash flow, which we used to repay $112.1 million of debt, reinforcing our commitment to strengthen our balance sheet. I'm delighted by the improved performance in our VWR Distribution and Services segment, which returned to positive organic revenue growth more quickly than we anticipated. Also, our Bioscience and Medtech Products segment performed near the high end of our expectations. We continue to focus on creating a better experience for our customers and delivering long-term value for our shareholders," Ligner concludes. Second Quarter 2026 For the three months ended June 30, 2026, net sales were $1,692.3 million, which was up 0.5% compared to the second quarter of 2025. Foreign currency translation had a positive impact of 0.9%, resulting in a 0.4% decline in net sales on an organic basis. Net income decreased to $38.1 million from $64.7 million in the second quarter of 2025, and net income margin was 2.3%; adjusted net income was $143.3 million compared to $161.2 million in the prior-year period. Adjusted EBITDA was $254.3 million, with an adjusted EBITDA margin of 15.0%. Operating income was $121.8 million, with an operating income margin of 7.2%; adjusted operating income was $225.1 million, with an adjusted operating income margin of 13.3%. Diluted earnings per share on a GAAP basis was $0.06, and adjusted diluted earnings per share was $0.21. Second Quarter 2026 – Segment Results VWR Distribution & Services Net sales were $1,240.5 million, a reported increase of 2.7%, as compared to $1,207.5 million in the second quarter of 2025. Foreign currency translation had a positive impact of 1.0%, resulting in a sales increase of 1.7% on an organic basis. Adjusted Operating Income was $126.4 million as compared to $141.6 million in the comparable prior period. Adjusted Operating Income margin was 10.2%. Bioscience & Medtech Products Net sales were $451.8 million, a reported decrease of 5.1%, as compared to $475.9 million in the second quarter of 2025. Foreign currency translation had a positive impact of 0.5%, resulting in a 5.6% sales decline on an organic basis. Adjusted Operating Income was $117.6 million, as compared to $131.4 million in the comparable prior period. Adjusted Operating Income margin was 26.0%. Adjusted Operating Income is Avantor's segment reporting profitability measure under generally accepted accounting principles and is used by management to measure and evaluate the performance of our Company's business segments. Balance Sheet and Cash Flow As of June 30, 2026, total debt, gross, was $3,715.4 million and cash and cash equivalents were $306.8 million. GAAP net leverage was (5.9x), and adjusted net leverage was 3.3x, as of June 30, 2026. For the three months ended June 30, 2026, operating cash flow was $178.2 million, while free cash flow was $142.8 million. Updated 2026 Guidance Avantor updates its fiscal 2026 financial guidance. We are unable to provide a reconciliation of the non-GAAP measures provided in our full-year 2026 guidance without unreasonable effort because of the difficulty in forecasting and quantifying certain amounts and adjustment items with a reasonable degree of certainty including net income, restructuring charges, foreign currency exchange gains and losses and income tax expense. These amounts are dependent upon future events and may be outside of our control. We note that the actual impact of these items may have potentially significant impact on our full-year results determined in accordance with GAAP. (2) Excludes cash restructuring costs. Fiscal 2026 Assumptions Reported revenue range is 0.0% to +1.0%, reflecting 0.5% foreign exchange tailwind Blended EUR/USD exchange rate of 1.15 Net interest expense is expected to decline modestly when compared to Fiscal 2025 Adjusted effective tax rate of approximately 22.5% Fully diluted share count of 677M shares Conference Call We will host a conference call to discuss our results today, July 29, 2026 at 8:00 a.m. Eastern Time. The live webcast and presentation, as well as a replay, will be available on the investor section of Avantor's website . About Avantor Avantor® is a leading life science tools company and global provider of mission-critical products and services to the life sciences and advanced technology industries. We work side-by-side with customers at every step of the scientific journey to enable breakthroughs in medicine, healthcare, and technology. Our portfolio is used in virtually every stage of the most important research, development and production activities at more than 300,000 customer locations in 180 countries. For more information, visit corporate.avantorsciences.com and find us on LinkedIn , X (Twitter) and Facebook . Use of Non-GAAP Financial Measures To evaluate our performance, we monitor a number of key indicators. As appropriate, we supplement our results of operations determined in accordance with U.S. generally accepted accounting principles ("GAAP") with certain non-GAAP financial measures that we believe are useful to investors, creditors and others in assessing our performance. These measures should not be considered in isolation or as a substitute for reported GAAP results because they may include or exclude certain items as compared to similar GAAP-based measures, and such measures may not be comparable to similarly titled measures reported by other companies. Rather, these measures should be considered as an additional way of viewing aspects of our operations that provide a more complete understanding of our business. We strongly encourage investors to review our consolidated financial statements included in reports filed with the SEC in their entirety and not rely solely on any one single financial measure or communication. The non-GAAP financial measures used in this press release are sales growth (decline) on an organic basis, Adjusted Operating Income, Adjusted Operating Income margin, Adjusted EBITDA, Adjusted EBITDA margin, adjusted net income, adjusted EPS, adjusted net leverage, free cash flow and free cash flow conversion. Organic net sales growth (decline) eliminates from our reported net sales change the impacts of revenues from acquisitions and divestitures that occurred in the last year (as applicable) and changes in foreign currency exchange rates. We believe that this measurement is useful to investors as a way to measure and evaluate our underlying commercial operating performance consistently across our segments and the periods presented. This measure is used by our management for the same reason. Adjusted Operating Income is our operating income or loss adjusted for the following items: (i) amortization of acquired intangible assets, (ii) charges associated with the impairment of certain assets, (iii) gain on sale of business, and (iv) certain other adjustments. Adjusted Operating Income margin is Adjusted Operating Income divided by net sales as determined under GAAP. We believe that these measures are useful to investors as ways to analyze the underlying trends in our business consistently across the periods presented. These measures are used by our management for the same reason. Additionally, Adjusted Operating Income is our segment reporting profitability measure under GAAP. Adjusted EBITDA is our net income or loss adjusted for the following items: (i) interest expense, (ii) income tax expense, (iii) amortization of acquired intangible assets, (iv) depreciation expense, (v) losses on extinguishment of debt, (vi) charges associated with the impairment of certain assets, (vii) gain on sale of business, and (viii) certain other adjustments. Adjusted EBITDA margin is Adjusted EBITDA divided by net sales as determined under GAAP. We believe that these measures are useful to investors as ways to analyze the underlying trends in our business consistently across the periods presented. These measures are used by our management for the same reason. Adjusted net income is our net income or loss first adjusted for the following items: (i) amortization of acquired intangible assets, (ii) losses on extinguishment of debt, (iii) charges associated with the impairment of certain assets, (iv) gain on sale of business, and (v) certain other adjustments. From this amount, we then add or subtract an assumed incremental income tax impact on the above-noted pre-tax adjustments, using estimated tax rates, to arrive at Adjusted Net Income. We believe that this measure is useful to investors as a way to analyze the business consistently across the periods presented. This measure is used by our management for the same reason. Adjusted EPS is our adjusted net income divided by our diluted GAAP weighted average share count adjusted for anti-dilutive instruments. We believe that this measure is useful to investors as an additional way to analyze the underlying trends in our business consistently across the periods presented. This measure is used by our management for the same reason. Adjusted net leverage is equal to our gross debt, reduced by our cash and cash equivalents, divided by our trailing 12-month Adjusted EBITDA (excluding stock-based compensation expense and including the expected run-rate effect of cost synergies and the incremental results of completed acquisitions and divestitures as if those acquisitions and divestitures had occurred on the first day of the trailing 12-month period). We believe that this measure is useful to investors as a way to evaluate and measure the Company's capital allocation strategies and the underlying trends in the business. This measure is used by our management for the same reason. Free cash flow is equal to our cash flows from operating activities, less capital expenditures, plus direct transaction costs and income taxes paid related to acquisitions and divestitures (as applicable) in the period. Free cash flow conversion is free cash flow divided by adjusted net income. We believe that these measures are useful to investors as they provide a view on the Company's ability to generate cash for use in financing or investing activities. These measures are used by our management for the same reason. Reconciliations of these non-GAAP financial measures to the most directly comparable GAAP financial measures are included in the tables accompanying this release. title: 'I Will Find You’ Tracks Down Most Popular List as Book Sales Soar
summary: Since its June 18 premiere, the limited series has racked up 101.8M views and counting and hit #1 in 81 countries around the world.
body_text: Audiences are having no trouble tracking down Harlan Coben’s new mystery series on Netflix. I Will Find You , the latest adaptation from the best-selling author’s library, has officially entered our Most Popular Shows of All Time list at #10. Since its June 18 premiere, the limited series has racked up 101.8M views and counting. I Will Find You marks our biggest scripted series debut of the year and has hit #1 in 81 countries . The show spent five weeks at #1 on the Global Top 10 English TV list , the first series to do so since Wednesday Season 2 in September 2025. And I Will Find You’ s popularity extends far beyond the screen. Even before the series launched on Netflix, anticipation for the adaptation sparked a surge in popularity for the source material three years after its publication. "Since the series announcement and teaser trailer drop on June 1, sales of I Will Find You have increased over 500%,” said Beth de Guzman, SVP Deputy Publisher, Grand Central Publishing. I Will Find You is just the latest chapter in our long-standing creative partnership with Coben, dating back to 2018. The Harlan Coben Universe — or the HCU as we like to call it — spans 13 adaptations in 6 countries , including: The UK: Fool Me Once, Missing You , Run Away, Safe, Stay Close , The Stranger France: Gone for Good Poland: Hold Tight , The Woods Argentina: Caught Spain: The Innocent The US: I Will Find You Since the debut of the Netflix Top 10 in 2021, our Coben adaptations have made Netflix’s weekly Global Top 10 list 41 times and reached the Top 10 in 93 countries. Since 2023, Coben's shows have amassed over 450M global views . I Will Find You follows the 2024 adaptation of Coben’s Fool Me Once , which also previously appeared on the Most Popular Shows list. Earlier this year, our adaptation of his novel Run Away spent four weeks on the Global Top 10 English Shows list, reaching the Top 10 in 84 countries and hitting #1 in 18. Britt Lower and Harlan Coben behind the scenes of ‘I Will Find You.’ (Courtesy of Netflix © 2026) I Will Find You is just the latest 2026 release to break into our most popular lists, following the gripping limited series His & Hers (previously #10 on the Most Popular Shows) and the animated film Swapped (#10 on the Most Popular Movies of All Time ). In addition to I Will Find You and His & Hers , other series breakouts this year include Nemesis , which garnered 30M views, spent five weeks on the Global Top 10 English Shows list and appeared in the Top 10 in 89 countries. And Bridgerton Season 4 spent nine weeks in the Global Top 10 English Shows list, reached #1 in 85 countries and drew 100M views in the first 6 months of 2026, nearly tripling the viewership of every earlier entry in the franchise — including Queen Charlotte: A Bridgerton Story. I Will Find You also joins an illustrious list of adaptations on our most popular lists, such as multiple seasons of Bridgerton , Leave the World Behind and The Queen’s Gambit. In 2025, book adaptations drove over 9B global views and represented nearly 20% of total view hours on Netflix. And the story’s far from over. We recently renewed our partnership with Coben, which continues with a new UK adaptation of The Woods and Myron Bolitar , based on Coben’s longest-running series. I Will Find You — and the entire HCU — is another testament to our ability to not only faithfully adapt novels for the screen, but to turn these stories into culture-defining moments that spark new fandoms, expand worlds and bolster book sales and audiobook streams. (Learn more about our latest adaptations here .) I Will Find You is now streaming — only on Netflix.

title: Summer Slowdown or Focus Reset? How to Use July to Recalibrate
summary: Summer Slowdown or Focus Reset? How to Use July to Recalibrate
body_text: July hits different. There’s something about the sticky air, slower mornings, and long golden evenings that makes everything feel... paused. Even your inbox feels a little quieter. Maybe you’ve noticed yourself moving slower too—not necessarily out of laziness, but a kind of seasonal recalibration. The question is: are you resisting it, or leaning in? What if this midsummer lull wasn’t a productivity slump—but a built-in reset button? Here’s how to tell whether you’re in a summer slowdown or standing at the edge of a much-needed focus reset . And more importantly, how to use this month to recalibrate—without pressure, guilt, or overhauls. Is It Burnout, or Just Seasonal Shift? Sometimes, slowing down isn’t a problem to solve—it’s a rhythm to respect. But modern work culture tends to frame lower energy as something to push through. The truth? Seasonal changes affect your circadian rhythm , cortisol levels, and even your mental clarity. Signs it might be time for a focus reset: You’re scattered but not overwhelmed—just floating a little You’re craving structure but resisting strict systems You feel more reflective than reactive You’re not behind, but your momentum feels… fuzzy If that sounds like you, you don’t need to power through. You need to recalibrate. What a “Focus Reset” Actually Looks Like Recalibrating doesn’t mean rewriting your entire routine. It means tuning in and adjusting the dials. Think of it like switching from sprint mode to recovery training—you’re still moving, but with intention. Here’s how to approach it: 1. Audit Without Judgment Take 20 minutes to reflect: What’s actually working in your current routine? What feels heavy, forced, or outdated? Where are you craving change—but avoiding it? You don’t need a Notion dashboard for this. A blank note and honest thoughts are enough. 2. Pick One Focus Ritual to Reinforce Instead of redoing your whole schedule , pick one grounding habit to rebuild—something small that connects you to presence. A few ideas: Morning playlist and light stretch before screen time Midday Pomodoro with a reset soundscape Evening digital wind-down after dinner These anchor points create rhythm without demanding more from you. 3. Update Your Sound Environment July is a perfect time to switch up your focus soundscape . Try ambient tracks that match the season’s vibe—slow jazz, distant thunderstorms, cicada soundscapes, or soft water. Sound can cue your brain to shift from passive mode to focused flow, even when you’re low on motivation. 4. Time Block Around Energy, Not Output Reframe your calendar. Instead of asking: "What do I need to produce?" Try: "When do I feel most alert, and when do I need ease?" Summer might mean your focus window is 9am–1pm and your creative flow returns at night. That’s okay. Match tasks to energy, not tradition. July Is Not a Wasted Month It’s easy to treat July like a buffer month—between spring’s momentum and fall’s intensity. But it’s also one of the most emotionally intelligent times to reflect, edit, and realign without the pressure of January or the chaos of September. This is your invitation to: Step off autopilot Recommit to what matters Drop what’s draining you Let slowness teach you something Because slowing down doesn’t mean you’re stuck—it means you’re listening. Try This: Your 3-Step July Focus Reset If you want to start now, here’s a simple ritual to close your laptop with clarity each day: 1. Sound On: Play a 5-minute ambient track to mark the transition from “work” to “reflect.” 2. Three Questions: What felt good today? What felt off? What would help me feel clear tomorrow? 3. Set the Mood for Tomorrow: Queue up tomorrow’s first playlist. Choose your first task. Then close the tab. Your July doesn’t need to be big to be powerful. It just needs to be yours. ‍ If you enjoy this article and want to stay updated, join our newsletter Join newsletter

title: Best Options Trading Apps in India
summary: Looking for the best option trading app in India? Compare AlgoTest, Sensibull, StockMock, Opstra, Quantsapp, and Strike Money by features, pricing, and more.
body_text: Best Options Trading Apps in India AlgoTest Jul 30, 2026 • 6 min read • General • Markdown Twitter / X Facebook LinkedIn WhatsApp Ask ChatGPT Ask Claude Ask Grok Copy link An option trading app or platform is a tool that helps you analyze, build, and test options strategies, not a broker that holds your funds. Most of these apps plug into your existing broker account rather than replacing it. Picking the wrong one is an expensive mistake. An app that only shows you a payoff chart but can't backtest leaves you trading on instinct. An app that backtests well but can't take you live means switching tools right when momentum matters most. We compare six of the most-used option trading apps in India across the features that actually decide which one fits your workflow. Quick Comparison Platform Backtesting Strategy Builder Paper/Virtual Trading Live Execution Pricing Best For AlgoTest Yes, unlimited years, slippage and brokerage adjusted, 25 free/week Yes, no-code, up to 10 legs Yes, Option Simulator + Forward Testing on live data Automated, 60+ broker integrations Credits-based, from ₹499 Traders who want one platform from idea to live execution Sensibull Limited, no full historical backtest engine Yes, multi-leg with payoff and Greeks Yes, Draft Portfolios (live only) Manual, via linked broker Free tier; Pro from ₹800/month (free for Zerodha users) Beginners who want a simple, visual way to learn options StockMock Yes, expiry-cycle focused Yes Yes, Option Simulator No Paid subscription Traders who only need expiry-based backtesting Opstra Yes, EOD free, intraday needs Pro Yes, strategy finder + payoff calculator Yes, simulation and scanners Manual, via Definedge Free tier; Pro paid Traders who want deep quant-style analysis Quantsapp Yes, Trade Recap tool + historical edge analysis Yes, incl. pair trading Limited, analytics-focused Not built for direct execution Paid, from ₹3,250/month Experienced traders who treat options as a data problem Strike Money Yes, per platform's own listing Yes, multi-leg with Greeks Yes, simulations Not built for direct execution Paid, from ₹650/month Traders who want a visual, analytics-heavy dashboard Between the six, AlgoTest is the only one that covers backtesting, paper trading, and live execution without handing you off to a separate tool partway through. It's also the only one that runs a strategy unattended: Sensibull and Opstra can send orders to your broker, but you're still triggering each one manually. Sensibull and Strike Money are the easiest to look at; Opstra and Quantsapp go the deepest on pure analytics; StockMock does one job, expiry backtesting, and does it well. AlgoTest AlgoTest is a no-code algo trading software built around the full lifecycle of an options strategy: idea, backtest, paper trade, and live execution, all in one place. USP: One of the few platforms here that takes a strategy from historical testing to live deployment without switching tools. Key features: No-code, drag-and-drop strategy builder with up to 10 legs per strategy Backtesting across unlimited years, with slippage and brokerage costs factored in Option Simulator and Forward Testing for practicing on live market data before going live Live, automated execution through 60+ broker integrations, including order slicing, auto square-off, and trailing stop loss Portfolio-level testing and detailed trade analytics across strategies Signals AI for indicator-based strategies , alongside pure options strategies 25 free backtests every week, credits-based pricing starting at ₹499 Best for: Traders who don't want to rebuild their strategy in a different tool every time they move from testing to trading. Sensibull Sensibull is the most recognized name in Indian options analytics, built as a strategy and analysis layer on top of your existing broker account. USP: The cleanest, most beginner-friendly way to visualize an options strategy and its payoff. Key features: Multi-leg strategy builder with live payoff diagrams and Greeks Draft Portfolios for practicing strategies before going live FII/DII data, option chain, PCR, and max pain analysis Direct broker integration for execution (Zerodha, Upstox, Angel One, and others) What it's weakest on is historical backtesting. Sources disagree on exactly how limited it is, some describe it as unavailable entirely, others mention it on the Ultimate plan, so verify Sensibull's current backtesting scope directly if that's central to your decision. Best for: Beginners learning options basics, especially if you already trade on Zerodha, where Pro access is free. Related: Sensibull vs AlgoTest StockMock StockMock is a backtesting and simulation tool focused specifically on expiry-based options strategies. USP: Purpose-built expiry-cycle backtesting, without the feature clutter of a broader platform. Key features: Historical backtesting across weekly and monthly expiry cycles Option Simulator with multi-leg support Strategy builder with leg-wise stop loss and re-entry conditions Covers Nifty, BankNifty, FinNifty, Midcap Nifty, and Sensex What it doesn't have is forward testing or live execution. Once a strategy has been tested, you move to another platform to actually trade it. Best for: Traders who only need expiry-based backtesting and are comfortable executing elsewhere. Related: Stockmock vs AlgoTest Option Simulator Opstra (Definedge) Opstra is the most quant-leaning platform in this comparison, built around deep options analytics and scanners. USP: The depth of historical data and analysis tools makes it a favorite with serious, data-driven traders. Key features: Strategy finder and payoff calculator Backtesting, with EOD data free and intraday simulation on Pro Max pain and open interest analysis Live order placement through Definedge integration (manual, not rule-based automation) Worth knowing: some users report occasional UI glitches and mobile stability issues. Best for: Traders who prioritize understanding a strategy deeply over deploying it quickly. Related: Opstra vs AlgoTest Simulator Quantsapp Quantsapp positions itself as an options analytics tool for traders who treat options as a data problem first. USP: One of the widest ranges of options analytics tools in India, including support for pair trading strategies. Key features: Real-time Greeks, option chain, and volatility surface analysis Backtesting via its Trade Recap tool, plus historical edge and strategy performance analysis Positional and intraday trading analysis, including pair trading Education content for building options knowledge Worth knowing: at roughly ₹3,250/month, it's the most expensive platform in this comparison, and the learning curve is steeper than the others. Best for: Experienced traders who want data depth and don't mind paying for it. Strike Money Strike Money is built around visual, data-heavy options analysis. USP: A dashboard-first approach with real-time option chain data, IV charts, and payoff graphs. Key features: Multi-leg strategy builder with dynamic payoff visualization Greeks: Delta, Gamma, Theta, Vega, Rho Backtesting and simulation tools (per the platform's own listing; independent reviews are thinner here, worth a quick check before publishing) Heatmaps and alerts for spotting setups Best for: Traders who want a visually rich, analytics-first dashboard. Why AlgoTest Comes Out Ahead Every platform in this comparison does one thing particularly well. But if you're looking for a complete workflow, AlgoTest offers the most end-to-end experience. Complete trading workflow: Backtest, paper trade, and automate live execution—all on one platform. No platform switching: Move from historical testing to live markets without rebuilding your strategy elsewhere. Automated execution: One of the few platforms in this comparison that can execute rule-based strategies automatically after testing. Beyond options strategies: Build, backtest, and automate indicator-based strategies with Signals AI. Competitive pricing: Credit-based plans start at ₹499 , making it a cost-effective option compared to tools like Quantsapp (from ₹3,250/month) while covering more of the trading lifecycle. Option Trading Platforms vs Broker Apps If you're looking for an option trading app , it's worth knowing that broker apps and options trading platforms serve different purposes. Zerodha Kite – Best for placing options trades with low brokerage and a clean interface. Upstox – Good for active F&O traders looking for fast order execution. Groww – Beginner-friendly app with a simple investing and options trading experience. Angel One – Offers options trading alongside research tools and SmartAPI. Dhan – Popular among active traders for advanced order types and TradingView charts. For strategy building, backtesting, paper trading, and automation, traders typically pair these broker apps with platforms like AlgoTest, Sensibull, StockMock, or Opstra . Pick the Right Option Trading App The best platform depends on how you trade. If your priority is visual strategy analysis, tools like Sensibull and Opstra are strong choices. If you're focused on backtesting, StockMock is worth considering. But if you want to build, test, and automate your strategies in one place, AlgoTest offers the most complete workflow. title: Building a Stronger Cloud Ecosystem for Australian Customers
summary: Australian organisations are embracing cloud technologies to modernise operations, strengthen resilience and support innovation.
body_text: By Stephen Bovis, Regional Managing Director, Australia and New Zealand, Oracle—July 28, 2026 Australian organisations are embracing cloud technologies to modernise operations, strengthen resilience and support innovation. Whether they are running business-critical applications, modernising infrastructure, or exploring AI, organisations are looking for greater flexibility as they respond to changing business needs. Just as importantly, they're looking for trusted partners to help them navigate that journey. That is why Oracle continues to invest in strengthening Australia's partner ecosystem. By making Oracle technologies more accessible through experienced partners, we can help organisations of all sizes adopt cloud services with confidence and realise greater value from their technology investments. Our collaboration with Ingram Micro through Oracle's Cloud Distribution Program is an important example of that commitment. By expanding access to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) through one of Australia's leading technology distributors, we are enabling more partners to deliver Oracle cloud services and build the capabilities needed to support customers over the long term. Through Ingram Micro, partners will also have access to Oracle's broader portfolio of database, data management and enterprise technologies, helping them address a wider range of customer needs. The collaboration extends beyond expanded distribution. It is designed to give partners the resources, enablement and support needed to build sustainable Oracle cloud practices. Ingram Micro plans to support this collaboration with dedicated sales and technical resources, partner recruitment, enablement, demand generation and go-to-market investment. It will also use its AI-powered Xvantage™ platform to help partners discover, manage, and develop Oracle opportunities throughout the customer lifecycle. For customers, this can provide greater access to Oracle technologies and expertise through partners they already know and trust, helping support their modernisation and technology-adoption efforts. Australia's technology ecosystem continues to evolve, creating new opportunities for partners to help customers modernise and innovate. By strengthening our collaboration with distributors such as Ingram Micro, we are investing in an ecosystem that expands customer choice, builds partner capability, and makes it easier for organisations to access Oracle cloud technologies while allowing them to continue selecting the vendors and solutions that best suit each customer. Strong relationships with our partner community have always been central to Oracle's success. By continuing to invest in that community, we can help more Australian organisations take advantage of cloud innovation, today and into the future.

title: Latest CarGurus Brand Campaign Celebrates Life’s Big Deal Moments, Like Buying or Selling a Car
summary: CarGurus launched its latest national brand campaign, “Big Deal”, recognizing the important role cars play in people’s lives and the significance of making the right decision during a purchase or sale.
body_text: CarGurus, Inc. (Nasdaq: CARG), the No. 1 visited site for shopping, buying, and selling new and used cars (1), today announced the launch of its latest national brand campaign, “Big Deal”, recognizing the important role cars play in people’s lives and the significance of making the right decision during a purchase or sale. The new spots empathize with the big decisions drivers make along the buy/sell journey to reach their ideal outcome, underscoring CarGurus' role in helping consumers find the best deal on their big deal. “CarGurus has joined drivers along this important journey for nearly two decades, developing the best tools and information to help consumers feel confident in their decisions as a growing share prefer to do more online before going to the dealership,” noted Dafna Sarnoff, CarGurus Chief Marketing Officer. “As a result, CarGurus has earned the trust of tens of millions of monthly users who turn to our site to make sure they find the best deal for their needs.” CarGurus is the No. 1 most visited car-shopping site (1), connecting buyers to the best deals by providing complete vehicle history and unbiased deal ratings on the largest selection of new and used vehicles in the U.S. (2) Added tools like price drop alerts and the ability to finance in advance enable confident decision-making in one of the biggest purchases of a person’s life. The platform also supports sellers with car pricing tools and the ability to instantly receive multiple offers to sell their car either completely online or through a local dealer in select markets, empowering them to choose the best deal. “Although CarGurus makes the process easy with all the tools and information you need to get the best deal, we don't want to lessen the gravity of the purchase and its significant impact on people's lives. Buying or selling a car is a huge decision, an emotional experience that we wanted to reflect in this campaign,” said Carter Collins, Partner and Managing Director of Bindery. “Beyond the excitement of working with the No. 1 most visited car shopping site (1), partnering with the CarGurus team has been one of our most rewarding and close-knit experiences to date.” The “Big Deal” campaign will run across TV networks and connected TV providers. The spots will be supplemented with digital and social executions, including influencer programs throughout the year. View the full campaign video library here: https://cargur.us/19jlLY .
